one_line: Google unveils top‑ranked Gemini 4 Carbon, Nvidia releases new model amid antitrust probe, and AI regulation tightens worldwide.

themes.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon leads benchmarks
themes.text: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier AI model that improves coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity, and is not yet publicly released. The model ranked #1 on the AI Index and led multiple cybersecurity benchmarks, scoring 89 points higher on WebDev Arena.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks

themes.title: Nvidia expands AI models amid probe
themes.text: Nvidia unveiled Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a 30‑billion‑parameter open‑weight model that transcribes audio in up to 40 languages, translates 31 languages and distinguishes eight speakers, alongside the Granary v2 multilingual speech dataset. At the same time, the U.S. Department of Justice opened a probe into Nvidia’s planned $12.93 billion purchase of Hugging Face, citing competition concerns.

stories.headline: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset
DOJ probes Nvidia's $13 billion Hugging Face acquisition

themes.title: OpenAI faces legal challenges
themes.text: A U.S. federal grand jury indicted OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan on a felony charge for intercepting oral communications in a company executive conference room. Separately, OpenAI was sued after a ChatGPT interaction allegedly advised a patient with epilepsy to reduce medication, leading to a wrongful‑death claim.

stories.headline: OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan indicted on felony for bugging executive conference room
OpenAI sued after ChatGPT allegedly guided epilepsy patient to taper medication

themes.title: AI regulation expands globally
themes.text: China released draft rules adding 23 AI‑related technologies, including large language models and chip designs, to its export‑control list. In the United States, New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed legislation prohibiting unsafe AI chatbot features for users under 18, while Malaysian customs seized $12.1 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur airport.

stories.headline: China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
Malaysian customs seize $12.1 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur airport
